sections.title: What is Sapphire FUE Hair Transplantation?

blocks.text: Safir FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) is one of the modern hair transplantation methods in which hair follicles are taken one by one and transplanted to balding or sparse areas.

In this technique, special tips made of sapphire mineral are used instead of classical steel tips during the grooving stage. Thanks to the thin and sensitive structure of sapphire tips, the channels where the hair follicles will be placed can be created in a more controlled manner.
This approach is considered one of the modern methods that contribute to achieving natural appearance and hair density targets in hair transplantation planning.
Features of Sapphire FUE Method
Thanks to the special sapphire tips used in the sapphire FUE technique:

items: Precise channel planning can be done
The areas where the hair follicles will be placed can be prepared in a controlled manner.
Natural hair growth angles can be created
High density planting plans can be made
It can be aimed to manage the healing process comfortably

blocks.text: Treatment results may vary depending on personal factors and hair structure.
Who is Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant Suitable for?
Following expert evaluation, the following candidates may be considered suitable:

items: People experiencing male pattern hair loss
Individuals with female pattern hair thinning
People experiencing receding hairline
Patients with openness in the crown area
Individuals with loss of density in the temple areas
Candidates with sufficient hair follicles in the donor area
People with suitable general health conditions

Hair Analysis and Planning
Hair loss level, donor area capacity and targeted density are evaluated.
Harvesting Grafts
Healthy hair follicles are taken one by one from the donor area and prepared for transplantation.
Groove Opening with Sapphire Tips
Using sapphire tips, micro channels are created where the hair follicles will be placed.
Placement of Grafts
The collected hair follicles are placed in the transplantation area, taking into account the natural hair growth direction and angles.
Tracking and Controls
The post-operative recovery process is monitored with regular check-ups.

pages.title: DHI Hair Transplantation
pages.heroSubtitle: Advanced Hair Transplantation Method for Natural Looking and Dense Hair
pages.summary: DHI hair transplantation; It is applied with a personalized plan that prioritizes natural appearance, healthy hair density, predictable results and patient safety.
overview: DHI hair transplantation process is specially planned according to the person's hair structure, hair loss level and expectations. Thanks to the detailed consultation before the treatment, your needs are analyzed and a road map suitable for you is created.

Purpose; is to achieve aesthetically successful, intense and permanent results by preserving the natural hairline. The post-treatment process is monitored with regular checks to ensure that the healing progresses safely and healthily.
Thanks to direct implantation with the Choi implanter pen, the transplantation angle, direction and density are controlled more precisely.

blocks.text: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) means "Direct Hair Transplantation" in Turkish.

In this method, hair follicles are taken from the donor area using a special medical Choi implanter pen and placed directly on the scalp with the same pen. Thus, channel opening and graft placement procedures, which are performed separately in classical hair transplantation methods, can be performed in a single stage.
While the DHI technique allows hair follicles to be placed in a more controlled and precise manner, it also helps protect existing hair.
What are the Advantages of DHI Hair Transplantation?

DHI method is considered one of the advanced technologies in the field of hair transplantation. It is especially preferred in thickening procedures and in cases where protecting existing hair is important.
Its main advantages are:

items: Canal opening and planting operations can be carried out simultaneously
More controlled placement of hair follicles
Obtaining a more intense and natural appearance
Helps protect existing hair
Opportunity to return to social life faster
Natural hairline design
Application with minimal trauma

blocks.text: Who is DHI Hair Transplant Suitable for?
DHI hair transplantation may be a suitable option for male and female patients who experience hair loss and want to increase hair density.
As a result of expert evaluation, people with the following characteristics may be considered as suitable candidates:

items: Those experiencing mild, moderate or severe hair loss
People with sufficient and healthy hair follicles in the donor area
Candidates with suitable general health conditions
People with realistic expectations
Patients who want to have thickening process while preserving their existing hair

blocks.text: How is DHI Hair Transplantation Applied?
The treatment process is planned individually and consists of the following stages:
Personalized Treatment Planning
After hair analysis and medical evaluation, the hair line is designed and the number of grafts needed is determined.
Harvesting Grafts
Hair follicles are carefully removed from the donor area under local anesthesia.
Direct Implantation
The collected grafts are placed directly on the scalp with the help of the Choi implanter pen. In this way, the planting angle, direction and density can be controlled more precisely.
Follow-up and Recovery Management
After the operation, the recovery process is monitored by the expert team and necessary care recommendations are shared.

blocks.text: Beard and mustache transplantation is among the applications that complement each other and are frequently preferred today. Beard transplantation is a cosmetic surgical procedure to correct the appearance of sparse, irregular or missing beard.
This procedure involves transplanting hair follicles to the beard area of the face. Thus, a more dense, regular and aesthetic beard appearance is achieved.
Beard transplantation is performed to increase beard density in men, to regulate the beard line, to cover scars or to fill areas where beard is missing.
What Techniques Are Used in Beard Transplantation?

Two basic techniques are generally preferred in beard transplantation: DHI and Sapphire FUE. Both techniques involve harvesting individual grafts (follicular units) from the donor area at the back of the head and then transplanting them to the desired area of ​​the face.
In the DHI technique, the surgeon removes the hair follicles one by one and transfers them to the target area without waiting with the help of a special device called the Choi Pen.
In the Sapphire FUE technique, hair follicles are taken from the donor area, then micro channels are opened in the target area and previously collected grafts are placed in these channels.
In our clinic, the Sapphire FUE method is mostly applied in beard transplantation, unlike the DHI method, which is frequently preferred in hair transplantation, as the results look more natural.
Both techniques are painless as they are performed under local anesthesia. The healing process is also very comfortable as it does not require any incisions or stitches.
During your evaluation with your specialist doctor, a treatment plan suitable for the beard density and shape you dream of is created.
It is possible to have natural and dense beards if your donor area is sufficient and your general health condition is suitable.
How is Beard Transplantation Done?
Beard and mustache transplantation is a single-session procedure performed under local anesthesia. It takes approximately 4-5 hours and no pain is felt during the procedure.
The day after the procedure, slight crusting may occur in the transplanted area. This situation is normal and will resolve itself in a short time.

blocks.text: Teeth whitening; It is an aesthetic application that aims to bring the color changes that occur over time in the tooth enamel and dentin layer to a lighter and brighter tone.
Discoloring habits such as tea, coffee, cigarettes, red wine, age-related changes and some medications can cause darkening in tooth color.
The whitening process aims to achieve a brighter appearance in accordance with the person's existing tooth structure, rather than pushing the tooth color beyond its natural limits.
Therefore, results may vary from person to person; Tooth structure, initial color and type of staining are the determining factors.

Safe and effective results can be achieved when the application is done in a controlled manner with professional products. The important point here is that superficial stains and color changes embedded in the internal structure of the tooth are different.
While superficial stains respond more quickly, deep stains may require longer periods of time or different protocols.
Additionally, teeth whitening is different from scaling or polishing. While cleaning removes surface deposits, whitening aims to chemically lighten the color of the tooth.
Teeth whitening is generally applied by two methods: office type whitening performed in a clinical environment and home type tray whitening under the supervision of a physician.
In office whitening, the gums are isolated with protective barriers and professional whitening gel is applied to the tooth surface. The process is completed by checking at regular intervals.
This method is frequently preferred because it provides a visible color lightening in a short time.
Light-assisted systems can be used in some applications; but the main effect comes from the gel applied safely and in the right concentration.
In home whitening, personalized transparent trays are prepared. The gel recommended by the doctor is applied to these plaques and used for a certain period of time.
This method provides a more gradual and controlled color lightening. It may also be a more comfortable option for people who tend to be sensitive.

blocks.text: Hollywood Smile; It is an aesthetic smile design approach that aims to obtain a more symmetrical, brighter and balanced smile with facial features by evaluating the color, form, alignment and gum harmony of the teeth together.
The goal is not just to whiten teeth; It is to design a natural and aesthetic smile that is compatible with the person's lip structure, facial proportions and facial expressions.

Therefore, the Hollywood Smile is not just a single procedure; It is a individually planned treatment. While small touches are sufficient in some cases, in some cases additional procedures such as veneers, bonding, orthodontics or gum alignment may be required.
Function is as important as aesthetics during the treatment process. The progress is made by preserving the closing of the teeth, chewing balance and speech function.
In a well-planned Hollywood Smile design; The size and width of the teeth, midline harmony, smile curve, gum level and tooth-lip relationship are evaluated together.

Rehearsal stages (mock-up / temporary design) are very important in terms of permanence and naturalness. The patient can give feedback by experiencing his new smile in daily life.
In the final stage, permanent restorations are applied, closure checks are performed and the process is completed with maintenance recommendations.

blocks.text: During the surgery, a horizontal incision is made in the lower abdomen. This incision is usually planned to coincide with the underwear line, thus keeping scar visibility to a minimum.

blocks.text: Liposuction is a surgical body shaping procedure performed to reduce local fat accumulations in the body and make body lines more balanced.
The most important point is that liposuction is not a weight loss method; It is a contour correction operation that targets stubborn fat deposits that are resistant to diet and exercise.
Fat cells are removed by vacuum with the help of special cannulas and a more prominent and aesthetic form is aimed in areas such as waist, abdomen and hips.
Liposuction, when applied to the right patients, can improve clothing fit, make body proportions more aesthetic and reduce complaints of regional excess.

However, if skin elasticity is low, there is severe overweight, or there is significant sagging, liposuction alone may not be sufficient. In these cases, additional skin tightening procedures or different surgical options may be considered.
Success is related to removing fat from the right areas and in a controlled amount in accordance with the body contours, rather than the amount of fat removed.
Liposuction surgery begins with examination and planning. Which areas will be shaped, skin elasticity, fat distribution and the patient's expectations are evaluated.
Before the operation, drawings are made to determine the areas where fat will be removed and symmetry in the body lines is planned.

Process; Depending on the scope, it can be performed under local anesthesia, sedation or general anesthesia. In most techniques, a special liquid mixture called "tumescent" is administered to the fat tissue to control bleeding and facilitate fat removal.

Then, the fat tissue is entered with thin cannulas through very small incisions and the fat is removed with vacuum. The surgeon works in a controlled and layered manner to achieve a homogeneous appearance and reduce the risk of collapse.
At the end of the procedure, a corset is usually worn. This corset; It helps reduce edema, allow tissues to adapt to the new contour and ensure healing progresses more regularly.
In the postoperative period, factors such as walking, nutrition and corset use directly affect the quality of the result.

blocks.text: “Which is the best laser epilation?” There is no single answer to the question. Because the most appropriate method is; It varies depending on the person's skin tone, hair structure, hormonal status, application area and treatment goals.

blocks.text: Laser epilation generally shows its most effective results on hair in the anagen (active growth) phase. For this reason, treatment is often not completed in a single session. sections.title: How to Compare Hair Transplantation Methods?

blocks.text: The main distinction in modern hair transplantation is in the way the grafts are collected and placed. In FUE family methods, grafts are taken one by one; In DHI, grooving and placement can proceed in the same sequence.
Sapphire FUE

Micro channels opened with sapphire-tipped blades can offer a more controlled planning opportunity on graft direction and density. It is especially preferred in large area transplants and natural hairline design.
DHI
Direct implantation with the Choi implanter pen; It stands out in cases of thickening where existing hair needs to be protected and in areas where angle-direction sensitivity is high.
Supportive treatments

items: ACell PRP: Can be evaluated for healing and graft surrounding support purposes
Exosome therapies: Can be planned in scalp quality and support protocols
Laser-assisted treatments: Can be added to pre/post-operative programs

blocks.text: The choice of method is not based on the slogan "the newest technique"; It should be done with donor quality, target density, shaving preference and recovery expectation. You can access detailed method pages in the relevant treatments section.

For suitable candidacy, general health status, medication use, donor area density and realistic expectations are evaluated together. Active dermatological problems or uncontrolled systemic diseases may delay the process.

items: Administration of blood thinners and some supplements before surgery
Smoking/alcohol restriction and scalp preparation
Washing, sleeping position, and avoiding trauma in the first 7–14 days
Knowing that the shock shedding period is a normal process
Result maturation calendar extending up to 12 months

blocks.text: Healing speed varies from person to person. The clinical team shares a written care protocol with the priority of graft safety and natural appearance.

faqs.question: How to choose between FUE and DHI?
faqs.answer: Choice; It is done according to donor capacity, target area, need to protect existing hair and desired density profile. During the consultation, the pros and cons of both methods are explained individually.

faqs.question: When does the natural look occur after hair transplantation?
faqs.answer: Initial recovery is usually completed in 1–2 weeks. After shock shedding, growth progresses gradually; The final outlook is evaluated at 9–12 months in most cases.

faqs.question: Can PRP or exosome replace hair transplantation?
faqs.answer: No. These applications can be planned as supporting protocols; It does not replace graft transplantation in case of advanced shedding.
